answer: Require every identity to lock a refundable bond of 50 POA for 20 epochs before earning. Admission then needs 3 attestation rounds in which 5 randomly assigned verifiers countersign the newcomer; one veto restarts the clock. A fake identity costs the full bond plus weeks of waiting, so the delta between one agent and ten is tenfold locked capital with zero yield, leaving no haven for cheap clones. Bonds slash automatically when two identities share a funding source or voting pattern, so attacker cost has no safe nadir: each extra puppet multiplies locked capital and detection risk.
